purpose: provenance of the data root the template's attested computation reads: one synthetic monthly series, generated rather than retrieved
credentials: none: nothing in this root is fetched from a service

files.description: 48 monthly values from 2020-01 to 2023-12 near 1.0 with a small annual cycle and a slower modulation, closed form and rounded to four decimals, so the same bytes come out on every machine and the attester can regenerate them

note: A data root is data, and data is knowledge: a capability whose computation reads retrieved granules keeps them, their stamps and their record files here in the same way. Nothing under knowledge/ is runnable; the code that reads this root is the executor in the skill that runs it.
